column3: bare .md becomes .html
per-version anchor is preserved
query string is preserved
subdirectory and parent-relative paths keep their prefix
uppercase extension is handled
root README.md maps to the directory, not README.html
README.md in a subdirectory maps to that directory
the theme edit link is left alone
other schemes and protocol-relative URLs are left alone
site-absolute .md is still rewritten
html, js and fragment hrefs are left alone
a path that merely contains .md is not a match
.planning links are left as-is because Jekyll never publishes them
non-string input is returned as given
sourceFile maps a rendered page back to its source .md
a label that is exactly the old filename follows the href
surrounding whitespace in the label survives
descriptive labels are never touched
README keeps its name, since the index has no filename to show
an unchanged href never relabels
non-string label is returned as given
the DOM half of the module is exported
retirement_optimizer.html closes every inline tag it opens
every changelog version stamp sits in its own <li>
every .toggle checkbox has a visible switch, and no label is nested in a label
every README or changelog reference in the page is a link that opens a new tab
every README section a link names is a heading in README.md
